scene.name: The Instrument That Never Existed
scene.text: The boy binds hollow reeds, a gourd, shells and stretched fibers into an instrument no musician recognizes. Its strange voice makes an elder remember a half-forgotten lullaby. The boy is delighted by the sound, but even more delighted that the elder begins singing.
